response.rationale: The immunophenotype (CD138+, CD56+, CD20-, PAX5-, EBV+) and FISH gains (BCL6, MYC, IGH) strongly favor plasmablastic lymphoma, despite HIV negativity and localized disease. Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is a close second given the nasal location and CD56/EBV positivity, but the CD138 expression and B-cell-associated genetic gains are atypical. Other plasma cell or B-cell neoplasms are less consistent with the full profile.
